target: Prime 6 category breadth plus native Specs, accessibility contracts, interface microinteractions and machine guidance
referencePolicy: Prime category inventory only. No Prime assets, source or layouts copied.
status: active-build; native design drafts; not runtime certified

components.name: Forms/Select
components.purpose: Select one topic from a finite list.
components.semantics: Native select with associated visible label; browser popup.
components.keyboard: Native select keys and typeahead; Tab exits.

components.name: Forms/Combobox
components.purpose: Find a resource in a longer option set.
components.semantics: Tested combobox primitive with expanded/controls/active-descendant; named listbox and options.
components.keyboard: Arrows navigate, Enter selects, Escape closes; preserve editing keys.

components.name: Forms/Search
components.purpose: Search DesignA11y articles and resources.
components.semantics: Native search input in labelled search form; result status on submit.
components.keyboard: Enter submits; native editing and named clear control.

components.name: Forms/DateField
components.purpose: Enter a date with clear format and calendar alternative.
components.semantics: Native date input or tested date field; associated label and format help.
components.keyboard: Native editing; no blocked manual entry; named calendar trigger.

components.name: Forms/FileUpload
components.purpose: Attach supporting material with explicit constraints.
components.semantics: Native file input with visible label; drag/drop is supplemental.
components.keyboard: Keyboard file chooser; separately named remove action; selection status.

components.name: Forms/Slider
components.purpose: Adjust a bounded value with numeric entry available.
components.semantics: Native range input or tested slider; name, min/max/value and value text; numeric alternative.
components.keyboard: Arrows step, Home/End reach bounds.

components.name: Forms/NumberStepper
components.purpose: Enter or step a bounded number without dragging.
components.semantics: Native number input and named decrement/increment buttons; bounds and errors.
components.keyboard: Native editing; ArrowUp/Down step; buttons Enter/Space.

components.name: Forms/DatePicker
components.purpose: Choose a date or range, retaining manual entry.
components.semantics: Tested date picker primitive; named dialog/grid, localized dates and week start.
components.keyboard: Arrow dates; Home/End, PageUp/Down per primitive; Enter selects; Escape returns focus.

components.name: Navigation/Item
components.purpose: Reusable labelled navigation destination.
components.semantics: Anchor for route changes; aria-current=page for current destination.
components.keyboard: Tab to link; Enter follows; do not use arrow keys for plain navigation.

components.name: Navigation/Tabs
components.purpose: Switch between related panels in one context.
components.semantics: Tested tabs primitive with tablist, tabs, selected state and labelled panels.
components.keyboard: Roving tab stop; Left/Right arrows, Home/End; manual activation if content is slow.

components.name: Navigation/Breadcrumbs
components.purpose: Show hierarchy and provide ancestor navigation.
components.semantics: Labelled breadcrumb nav with ordered list; final item aria-current=page.
components.keyboard: Only ancestor links are tab stops; compact overflow has a named control.

components.name: Navigation/Pagination
components.purpose: Move through bounded result pages with clear current state.
components.semantics: Labelled pagination nav; links for destinations; aria-current=page; disabled previous/next not actionable.
components.keyboard: Tab through available links; Enter follows. No custom arrow navigation.

components.name: Navigation/Menu
components.purpose: Offer a short contextual action list.
components.semantics: Tested menu/menuitem primitive for actions; ordinary destination lists should remain links.
components.keyboard: Trigger Enter/Space opens; arrows, Home/End; Escape closes and restores trigger focus.

components.name: Navigation/Header
components.purpose: Consistent DesignA11y site identity, primary destinations and mobile menu.
components.semantics: Header landmark, home link, labelled primary nav; compact disclosure button with expanded/controls.
components.keyboard: Tab links; menu button Enter/Space; Escape closes disclosure and returns focus; no desktop menubar role.

components.name: Navigation/Sidebar
components.purpose: Navigate resource and documentation sections.
components.semantics: Named navigation landmark with links and optional disclosure sections; current page indicated.
components.keyboard: Tab links/disclosures; Enter/Space toggles section; no tree role unless full tree pattern implemented.

components.name: Navigation/Footer
components.purpose: Consistent secondary navigation, brand context and legal links.
components.semantics: Footer landmark; separately named nav groups; descriptive link text.
components.keyboard: Normal link order follows visual and document order.
components.migrationNote: Flattened Description removed during source alignment; native tagline and separately editable labels. See current native Spec.

components.name: Feedback/Alert
components.purpose: Persistent contextual feedback with explicit meaning.
components.semantics: Status or alert only when dynamically appropriate; static alert panels need no live role. Severity is named in text, not color alone.
components.keyboard: Text is not focusable; actions and dismiss buttons are.

components.name: Feedback/Toast
components.purpose: Nonblocking outcome notification without losing task context.
components.semantics: Tested notification region; polite status by default; persistent if action required; no essential timed-only content.
components.keyboard: Do not steal focus; actionable notifications have discoverable controls and enough time.

components.name: Feedback/Tooltip
components.purpose: Supplement a clear control label with brief nonessential help.
components.semantics: Tested tooltip; role=tooltip associated through describedby; no interactive content.
components.keyboard: Shown on focus and hover; Escape dismisses; remains while pointer is over it; never sole accessible name.

components.name: Feedback/Progress
components.purpose: Communicate measurable completion without animation dependence.
components.semantics: Native progress with accessible label and known max/value; omit numeric value if unknown; error is textual.
components.keyboard: Not focusable unless it contains an action; status announcements throttled.

components.name: Feedback/Loading
components.purpose: Give a stable pending-operation status and completion feedback.
components.semantics: Named status; aria-busy on affected region; avoid repeated announcements.
components.keyboard: Do not move focus or disable unrelated controls; cancellation if operation warrants.

components.name: Feedback/Skeleton
components.purpose: Reserve content geometry during loading without visual noise.
components.semantics: Decorative aria-hidden skeleton; one adjacent loading status. Static by default.
components.keyboard: Never focusable; no fake interactive controls.

components.name: Feedback/EmptyState
components.purpose: Explain absence of content and a useful next action.
components.semantics: Heading and explanation; no live-region by default; avoid blame and decorative over-explanation.
components.keyboard: Clear next action in reading order.

components.name: Feedback/ErrorState
components.purpose: Explain a failed task with recovery and preserved input.
components.semantics: Visible heading/message; alert only for newly occurring urgent errors; accessible recovery link/button.
components.keyboard: Focus remains logical; failed submit may focus error summary; never discard entered content.

components.name: Content/Badge
components.purpose: Compact noninteractive category or status label.
components.semantics: Plain text; never rely on color; not a button.
components.keyboard: Not a tab stop.

components.name: Content/Tag
components.purpose: Represent a topic or chosen filter.
components.semantics: Static text, link or named toggle according to use; remove button includes tag name.
components.keyboard: Interactive tag Enter/Space per role; remove is a distinct named action.

components.name: Content/Avatar
components.purpose: Represent an author or contributor without requiring a photo.
components.semantics: If adjacent name is present, decorative; otherwise meaningful name equivalent. Never infer identity from image.
components.keyboard: Not focusable unless a separate profile link.

components.name: Content/Rating
components.purpose: Collect helpfulness feedback, never an accessibility conformance score.
components.semantics: Read-only text summary or tested radio group with each value named; do not use icon color as sole value.
components.keyboard: Radio group arrows and Space; visible labels for choices; submit if required.

components.name: Content/ArticleCard
components.purpose: Link to one editorial article with a clear title and reading context.
components.semantics: Article with heading and one primary link; whole-card activation must not create duplicate tab stops. Decorative image empty alt when title gives context.
components.keyboard: One primary article link; Enter follows; focus surrounds whole card.
components.motion: Approved card-lift: -3px/140ms where appropriate; static reduced-motion/coarse-pointer feedback.

components.name: Content/ResourceCard
components.purpose: Present a practical toolkit, guide or downloadable resource.
components.semantics: Heading and descriptive link; download format/size explicit; avoid nested interactive card targets.
components.keyboard: Separate actions only when necessary; clear order and focus.

components.name: Content/FeaturedStory
components.purpose: Feature a single priority story without repeating it in the next article list.
components.semantics: Section with heading, summary and primary link; image purpose explicitly assigned.
components.keyboard: Logical heading/link order; no duplicate links to same story within card.

components.name: Content/AuthorProfile
components.purpose: Identify article authors and provide relevant context.
components.semantics: Visible author name; adjacent avatar decorative; profile link has descriptive name.
components.keyboard: Only profile/social links are tab stops.

components.name: Content/Metadata
components.purpose: Present date, reading time, format or revision consistently.
components.semantics: Text and native time element with machine-readable datetime; format information belongs in link context.
components.keyboard: Not focusable unless containing a meaningful category link.

components.name: Content/Accordion
components.purpose: Reveal optional supporting detail without hiding essential task instructions.
components.semantics: Native details/summary or tested disclosure; button expanded/controls; heading level follows context.
components.keyboard: Enter/Space toggles; Tab moves normally; no mandatory arrow model.
components.motion: da.motion.disclosure; 160ms proposed measured-height transition, static alternative.

components.name: Content/ListItem
components.purpose: Present one resource, task or destination in a scan-friendly list.
components.semantics: List item containing a link, button or checkbox according to intent; avoid ambiguous clickable containers.
components.keyboard: Native link/button/selection behavior, no custom listbox unless actual selection widget.

components.name: Content/Quote
components.purpose: Separate quoted editorial content and attribution.
components.semantics: Blockquote with citation; no invented endorsement or testimonial.
components.keyboard: Static text; citation link only if provided.

components.name: Content/PricingCard
components.purpose: Provide an optional access-plan pattern for future offerings, not a claim of a current paid product.
components.semantics: Heading, price and billing terms as text; descriptive action; no hidden recurring cost.
components.keyboard: Native action/link; clear unavailable state.

components.name: Content/Review
components.purpose: Present verified resource feedback without inventing testimonials.
components.semantics: Review text, rating meaning and attribution; sample content must be replaced by verified feedback.
components.keyboard: Only helpfulness/report actions are interactive.

components.name: Content/ArticleBody
components.purpose: Readable long-form editorial structure with headings and linked resources.
components.semantics: Semantic article headings, paragraphs and lists; heading hierarchy follows page context.
components.keyboard: Links in document order; no focusable body wrapper.

components.name: Actions/ButtonSecondary
components.purpose: Secondary action hierarchy
components.semantics: Native button; explicit type and accessible action label
components.keyboard: Enter/Space; focus static; loading preserves context

components.name: Actions/ButtonTertiary
components.purpose: Tertiary action hierarchy
components.semantics: Native button; explicit type and accessible action label
components.keyboard: Enter/Space; focus static; loading preserves context

components.name: Actions/ButtonDestructive
components.purpose: Destructive action hierarchy
components.semantics: Native button; explicit type and accessible action label
components.keyboard: Enter/Space; focus static; loading preserves context

components.name: Overlays/Dialog
components.purpose: Focus a bounded task requiring an explicit response.
components.semantics: Tested modal dialog primitive or native dialog; labelled by heading; background inert; nonmodal remains distinct.
components.keyboard: Initial focus intentional; Tab trapped inside modal; Escape closes when safe; restore invoking control focus.

components.name: Overlays/Drawer
components.purpose: Offer contextual detail or filters without losing the underlying task.
components.semantics: Modal drawer uses dialog primitive; persistent desktop panel is an aside, not a focus trap.
components.keyboard: Modal Tab containment/Escape/return focus; persistent panel follows document order.

components.name: Overlays/Popover
components.purpose: Show a small contextual surface tied to a trigger.
components.semantics: Tested nonmodal popover; role based on content, not automatic tooltip/menu. Trigger expanded and controls where appropriate.
components.keyboard: Trigger Enter/Space; content reachable logically; Escape dismisses and restores focus if it moved.

components.name: Overlays/PreferenceBanner
components.purpose: Give clear optional preference choices without coercion.
components.semantics: Named region with equivalent accept/reject or preference controls; no preselected optional consent.
components.keyboard: Logical controls; no focus trap unless intentionally modal; no disappearing time limit.

components.name: Actions/ButtonGroup
components.purpose: Group related actions with clear primary hierarchy.
components.semantics: Named group only when helpful; native buttons and links retain their semantics.
components.keyboard: Normal Tab order; use toolbar roving model only when intentionally implementing toolbar.

components.name: Actions/SegmentedControl
components.purpose: Choose a single compact view or mode.
components.semantics: Radio group for a setting; tabs only when controlling associated panels; do not mix roles.
components.keyboard: Radio-group arrows and Space, or tabs model when used as tabs; specify consuming intent.

components.name: Data/TableCell
components.purpose: Consistent table cell anatomy and content alignment.
components.semantics: th with scope for headers; td for data; numeric values preserve units; statuses explicit text.
components.keyboard: Cells are not tab stops in plain tables; only interactive descendants.

components.name: Data/Table
components.purpose: Compare structured resource information without sacrificing reading order.
components.semantics: Native table with caption and scoped headers. Sort buttons expose aria-sort. Row selection uses named checkboxes. Data grid only with full tested grid behavior.
components.keyboard: Normal tab order through sorting/actions/checkboxes; horizontal scroll keyboard-accessible if needed; do not add grid arrows to static tables.

components.name: Data/DescriptionList
components.purpose: Present labelled resource or system metadata.
components.semantics: Native dl/dt/dd for name/value relationships; do not substitute a table for unrelated facts.
components.keyboard: Static text; link values behave normally.

components.name: Data/FilterBar
components.purpose: Filter content with clear scope and reversible choices.
components.semantics: Labelled form/group with native controls, result count status and reset action.
components.keyboard: Tab to controls; Enter submits when applicable; removing filters announces result changes without stealing focus.

components.name: Data/ResourceList
components.purpose: Compose accessible resource list items with stable ordering.
components.semantics: Native list and labelled items; status separate from item names.
components.keyboard: Normal link order; loading does not remove focused content.

components.name: Assets/BrandMedia
components.purpose: Use the correct DesignA11y identity asset for context and scale.
components.semantics: Home link named DesignA11y home; decorative duplicates hidden; never substitute favicon for clean symbol at large size.
components.keyboard: Only a wrapping link is focusable.

components.name: Assets/PaymentMethod
components.purpose: Represent a payment category without copying licensed payment logos.
components.semantics: Visible payment method name; actual provider logos need approved official assets and license review. No current DesignA11y checkout implied.
components.keyboard: Static asset; selection uses separate radio group.

components.name: Assets/LocaleOption
components.purpose: Show locale with a written language and region, independent of flags.
components.semantics: Use language autonyms and region text; flags represent countries, never language alone. National-flag examples are original geometry, not language labels.
components.keyboard: Locale selection uses native select or tested menu; static preview is not interactive.

components.name: Assets/DeviceTemplate
components.purpose: Neutral original viewport frames for interface presentations.
components.semantics: Presentation-only original frame, not a device manufacturer mockup; nested screenshot requires contextual alternative.
components.keyboard: Decorative presentation frame, never an interactive control.

components.name: Layout/Container
components.purpose: Constrain readable content with consistent gutters.
components.semantics: Layout wrapper has no role by default; semantic section only with meaningful heading.
components.keyboard: No tab stop; visual order follows DOM order.

components.name: Layout/Grid
components.purpose: Responsive content grouping with source-order consistency.
components.semantics: CSS grid in implementation; no role from layout. Lists retain list semantics.
components.keyboard: Reading and focus order follow content; no CSS order that disagrees with DOM.

components.name: Layout/Divider
components.purpose: Separate meaningful content groups without adding visual clutter.
components.semantics: Decorative border by default; hr for thematic break; heading labels remain proper headings.
components.keyboard: Not focusable.

components.name: Layout/SpacingReference
components.purpose: Document reusable spacing scale and purposeful density.
components.semantics: Documentation reference only; use space variables instead of spacer DOM elements.
components.keyboard: Not interactive.

components.name: Patterns/Homepage
components.purpose: Editorial homepage hierarchy with toolkit prominence and distinct featured/latest content.
components.semantics: Header, main, labelled sections and footer; one h1; meaningful article links and reading order.
components.keyboard: Skip link first; consistent nav and card order; no duplicate featured story in next block.

components.name: Patterns/Article
components.purpose: Long-form article template with author, metadata and related resources.
components.semantics: Article landmark, one h1, publication time, byline and logical heading hierarchy.
components.keyboard: In-page links and related resources follow document order; skip repetitive navigation.

components.name: Patterns/ToolkitLanding
components.purpose: Route people to practical design, engineering and content guidance.
components.semantics: Main heading, introductory guidance and linked resource groups; revision provenance explicit.
components.keyboard: Clear headings and links; no hidden essential guidance.

components.name: Patterns/SearchResults
components.purpose: Search context, result count, filters and recovery.
components.semantics: Search landmark and main results region; polite result status; filters have labels.
components.keyboard: Search does not steal focus on result update; pagination preserves predictable navigation.

components.name: Patterns/PreferencesForm
components.purpose: Compose labelled form controls, help, validation and outcomes.
components.semantics: Native form with grouped controls, error summary and associated inline messages; preserve entered values.
components.keyboard: Submit validates; focus summary or first invalid according to flow; success status without unexpected focus change.

components.name: Patterns/MotionLab
components.purpose: Demonstrate and evaluate reusable production-interface microinteractions.
components.semantics: Named demo sections with instructions, explicit replay/pause where required and static alternatives. No live-site demo inventory claimed.
components.keyboard: Named controls operate by keyboard/touch; repeated animation is user initiated; preserve focus and alternative feedback.

validation.topLevelOverlapAudit: No overlapping top-level nodes on nine audited component/pattern pages.
visualSamples: Narrow homepage pattern 68:57; image/divider overflow corrected
limitations: Visual review sampled representative compositions, not every variant in every theme.
Native timeline tracks are authored; no new video export or runtime interaction validation claimed.
Meaningful semantic state in production requires native elements or tested primitives.
Some structural content examples and responsive variants need further depth; draft coverage is not release readiness.
Country flags are illustrative examples; icon/flag packs are not exhaustive.
Provider payment logos and branded device artwork are intentionally not copied.
